edge.title: SOAP eigenbasis preconditioning of momentum before NS on MLP weights
edge.summary: Adds SOAP-style preconditioning of the Nesterov momentum before the Contra-Muon/NorMuon-lite pipeline, for MLP weights only (mlp.fc, mlp.proj). Muon.step keeps EMAs (β 0.9) of GGᵀ and GᵀG from the raw gradient, takes their eigenbases (eigh at init, one power-iteration + QR refresh every 10 steps), and whitens the momentum Adam-style in that rotated basis (√ of an EMA, β2 0.9, of the squared rotated momentum, eps 1e-8) before rotating back and restoring its Frobenius norm. NS, Contra-Muon (now computed on the preconditioned momentum), NorMuon-lite and the u/w floor follow unchanged; the schedule ends at 3175 and the record is claimed at the step-3150 checkpoint.

changes.label: SOAP whitening of MLP momentum
changes.detail: For *.mlp.fc.weight / *.mlp.proj.weight, soap_precondition_momentum projects the momentum with q_row/q_col, updates exp_avg_sq (β2 = SOAP_BETA2 = 0.90), divides by √v + 1e-8, projects back and rescales to the input Frobenius norm before muon_update.

changes.label: Shampoo-basis tracking (every 10)
changes.detail: After the weight update, soap_update_preconditioner lerps row_gg/col_gg toward GGᵀ/GᵀG of the raw gradient (shampoo_beta 0.90), initializes the bases with eigh, and every 10 SOAP steps runs soap_basis_qr (sort by Rayleigh quotient, permute exp_avg_sq, QR of L·Q).

changes.label: train_steps 3225 → 3175, claim 3150
changes.detail: The linear cooldown (0.7) now ends at 3175; the record is claimed at the 3150 checkpoint, where the LR is ≈1.1% of peak.

changes.label: Momentum step moved into Muon.step
changes.detail: Nesterov momentum is computed in Muon.step with an out-of-place grad.lerp (keeping p.grad raw for the covariance statistics) and passed to muon_update, which is no longer @torch.compile'd; Muon now receives (name, param) pairs.

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest-code is #11; all #11 components (Contra-Muon 0.4, NorMuon-lite, u/w floor 0.35, lr 0.0375) are retained.
edge.noise: Log dir renamed to logs_v18 and version prints ('v18 is v13 with train_steps=3175'); muon_update signature/compile change and the aspect scale reading update.size instead of grad.size are refactors with identical math.

techniques.note: Nesterov mu=0.95, 12 NS iters, √max(1, m/n) scale, lr 0.0375; muon_update now runs uncompiled
mlp.fc/mlp.proj: momentum whitened in GGᵀ/GᵀG eigenbases (β 0.90, refresh every 10) before NS
−0.2·M/σ̂max(M) around NS (CONTRA_MUON=0.4); for MLP, M is the SOAP-preconditioned momentum

update scaled up to ‖u‖_F/‖w‖_F = 0.35 when below; wd 0.025 passed but never applied
AdamW lr embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0
flat, then linear to 0 over the last 70% of 3175 steps (all groups)
every param with 'proj' in its name zeroed (attn/mlp proj and lm head, weights and biases)

hparams.hidden.optimizer: Muon + SOAP (MLP) + Contra-Muon + NorMuon-lite + u/w floor
hparams.init.proj: zero (all params with 'proj' in name, incl. lm head and biases)

mechanisms.name: SOAP-Muon (MLP weights)
mechanisms.explain: For mlp.fc/mlp.proj, the optimizer keeps EMAs (β 0.9) of GGᵀ and GᵀG built from the raw gradient after each step, takes eigenbases Q_r, Q_c (eigh once, then one power-iteration + QR step every 10 steps), and keeps an EMA (β2 0.9) of the squared rotated momentum. Each step the Nesterov momentum is rotated (Q_rᵀ M Q_c), divided elementwise by √v + 1e-8, rotated back and rescaled to ‖M‖_F, so NS orthogonalizes a direction already whitened along the gradient's principal row/column axes. Step 0 uses the raw momentum because the basis is created only after the first update.

mechanisms.name: Mid-cooldown claim
mechanisms.explain: The LR schedule is defined for train_steps = 3175 (linear decay reaching 0 at 3175), but the record is claimed at the fixed step-3150 checkpoint, evaluated on all seeds, where the LR is still ≈1.1% of peak. Validation is logged at 3100/3125/3150/3175.

caveats: The second-moment EMA is of the rotated Nesterov momentum (not the rotated gradient as in standard SOAP); there is no eigenbasis first moment and no bias correction, and the statistics are one step stale (updated after use). Evidence is n=4 (mean 3.27759 at 3150). README: SOAP on all hidden matrices was tried and did not work without retuning. Effective Muon wd remains 0 (0.025 unused).
